verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Drata's API v2 offering only single-item create, update, list and delete endpoints, plus an MCP server for natural-language workflows. No bulk or batch endpoint and no multi-select bulk action in the product is documented. Scripting loops over per-item API calls, or listing and searching across workspaces, are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
